title: dogfood: main's Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3) is red since #25591 — showcase-d3-d4-capabilities still pins the pre-#25549 SHARING_NOT_ENABLED reason for a share on showcase_project
body:
Filing gate: ① — a reproducible defect (`main`'s push battery) with a named location. Filed by the fleet director project's `domain:server` card thread · `os-sales` · `session_014rFBGqoBLiroi35e82xEa7`, as the anchor for this failing check under the main-red convention (one failing check, one card). It holds the 18.1.0 cut.

Reader: this card thread; its PR fixes it (AGENTS.md "Main-red"; reading discipline: a red on `main` is stanched and filed by whichever lane finds it). The fix lands in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-d3-d4-capabilities.dogfood.test.ts`, which the lane table anchors to `domain:devx`; the red's cause is #25591's `plugin-sharing` change, a `domain:server` package, and the fleet director dispatched the stanch to the server lane, so this card carries `domain:server`. Triage may re-anchor it after the landing.

Business reason: `main`'s full battery is red, so the publish lane cannot read it green before a release approval, and 18.1.0 waits on it. Every PR whose author reads `main`'s Dogfood gate also sees a red it did not cause.

Dedupe: semantic issue search on this repository for "showcase-d3-d4-capabilities dogfood SHARING_NOT_ENABLED showcase_project main red" → 6 hits (closed included), none for this failure; "dogfood shard red on main after sharing public object external member #25591" → 9 hits, none for this failure (the nearest is #25549, closed, the card #25591 fixed). Open PRs matching "showcase-d3-d4" → 1, #25600, unrelated (plugin-approvals).

## What fails

| Run | Head | `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [40059211627](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40059211627) (push) | `ba6912c1a` (#25589) | green (whole CI run `success`) |
| [40059752268](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40059752268) (push) | `4a251927c` (#25591's merge) | red: 1 failed / 784 passed; shards 2/3 and 3/3 green |
| [40060187070](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40060187070) (push) | `a57643d3d` (#25592) | red: 1 failed / 797 passed; shards 2/3 and 3/3 green |

The one failure on both red heads is `test/showcase-d3-d4-capabilities.dogfood.test.ts:135`, "[#9237] the grant the rule reconciles is one the gates CONSULT — not refused as inert":

```text
expected [Function] to throw error matching /SHARING_NOT_ENABLED: 'showcase_project' is not under record-sharing enforcement/
Received: "SHARING_NOT_ENABLED: 'showcase_project' has a public sharing model, so a share row on it is consulted only for an external member of the record's organization, and that organization could not be resolved"
```

## Why it is #25591, and why the new reason is intended

- #25591 (letter A of the ruling on #25549) made the D7 pre-flight in `plugin-sharing` `sharing-service.ts` read the recipient on an effective-`public` object with a real `owner_id`: an `external` member of the record's organization is admitted, every other recipient is refused with the new wording, and a grant whose organization cannot be resolved is refused with its own named reason. Its body says so ("No organization resolved is refused with its own named reason").
- The pin grants on `showcase_project` (`public_read_write`) as a system caller, to `pj_absent` (a record id that names no row) and a synthetic recipient. Before #25591 the object half refused it from the OWD alone. Now the object half defers to the recipient half, the system path resolves the organization from the record, finds none, and answers the "could not be resolved" reason. The behaviour is the ruled one; the pin is stale.
- PR CI does not run the Dogfood shards (they are skipped on `pull_request` and `merge_group`), so #25591's checks were green.

## Done when

- The pin asserts the reason the ruled verdict gives for the contrast it draws (a staff recipient on a real `showcase_project` record is refused because it is not an external member of the record's organization), not the incidental "could not be resolved" reason that a non-existent record produces.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` passes that file on the fix head, and `main`'s next push battery reads `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` green.

## Lane effect

Under AGENTS.md "Main-red", this red is the owning lane's first work and no PR of that lane arms the queue until it clears. A release freeze is in effect: the fix PR opens as a draft and lands only after the coordinator relays the unfreeze.
